SELECT bu.*, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS room_count, COUNT(DISTINCT be.id) AS bed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cir.id) AS resident_count FROM building AS bu LEFT JOIN room AS r ON bu.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN bed AS be ON r.id = be.room_id LEFT JOIN check_in_record AS cir ON be.id = cir.bed_id AND cir.status = 1
AND bu.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{buildingQuery.buildingName}, '%')
AND bu.status = #{buildingQuery.status}
GROUP BY bu.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS room_count, COUNT(DISTINCT be.id) AS bed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cir.id) AS resident_count, COUNT(DISTINCT be.id) - COUNT(DISTINCT cir.id) AS free_bed_count FROM room AS r LEFT JOIN bed AS be ON r.id = be.room_id LEFT JOIN check_in_record AS cir ON be.id = cir.bed_id AND (cir.status = 1 OR cir.status = 2)
